text_en: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
text_cn: 因为约伯自以为义，那三个友人就不再回答他。

text_en: Then Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram, became angry. He was angry at Job because he justified himself rather than God;
text_cn: 那时，有个布次兰族的人，他是巴辣革耳的儿子厄里乌，为了约伯在天主前自以为义人，便大为愤怒；

text_en: he was angry also at Job’s three friends because they had found no answer, though they had declared Job to be in the wrong.
text_cn: 同时也对约伯的三个友人大为震怒，因为他们找不到适当的答复，又以天主为不公。

text_en: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were older than he.
text_cn: 厄里乌先等他们同约伯讲完话，因为他们都比他年老。

text_en: But when Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouths of these three men, he became angry.
text_cn: 他一见他们三人无话可说，遂大为愤怒。

text_en: Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite answered: “I am young in years, and you are aged; therefore I was timid and afraid to declare my opinion to you.
text_cn: 于是布次人巴辣革耳的儿子厄里乌发言说： 我年龄小，你们年纪大，故此我退缩畏惧，不敢在你们前表示我的见解。

text_en: I said, ‘Let days speak, and many years teach wisdom. ’
text_cn: 我心想：“老人应先发言，年高者应教人智慧。”

text_en: But truly it is the spirit in a mortal, the breath of the Almighty, that makes for understanding.
text_cn: 但人本来都具有灵性，全能者的气息赋与人聪明；

text_en: It is not the old that are wise, nor the aged that understand what is right.
text_cn: 并不是年高者就有智慧，老人就通晓正义。

text_en: Therefore I say, ‘Listen to me; let me also declare my opinion. ’
text_cn: 故此我请你们且听我说，我也要表示我的见解。

text_en: “See, I waited for your words, I listened for your wise sayings, while you searched out what to say.
text_cn: 直到如今，我等待你们讲话，静听你们的理论，等待你们寻出适当的言词；

text_en: I gave you my attention, but there was in fact no one that confuted Job, no one among you that answered his words.
text_cn: 但现今我已明白看出了，你们中没一个能驳倒约伯，能回答他的话的。

text_en: Yet do not say, ‘We have found wisdom; God may vanquish him, not a human. ’
text_cn: 你们不要说：“我们寻到了智慧！只有天主可说服他，人却不能。”

text_en: He has not directed his words against me, and I will not answer him with your speeches.
text_cn: 我决不那样辩论，也决不以你们说的话答复他。

text_en: “They are dismayed, they answer no more; they have not a word to say.
text_cn: 他们已心乱，不能再回答，且已穷于辞令。

text_en: And am I to wait, because they do not speak, because they stand there, and answer no more?
text_cn: 他们已不再讲话了，他们已停止，不再答话了，我还等什么？

text_en: I also will give my answer; I also will declare my opinion.
text_cn: 现在我要开始讲我的一段话，表示出我的见解。

text_en: For I am full of words; the spirit within me constrains me.
text_cn: 因为我觉着充满了要说的话，内心催迫着我。

text_en: My heart is indeed like wine that has no vent; like new wineskins, it is ready to burst.
text_cn: 看啊！我内心像寻觅出口的新酒，要将新酒囊爆裂。

text_en: I must speak, so that I may find relief; I must open my lips and answer.
text_cn: 我一说出，必觉轻松，我定要开口发言。

text_en: I will not show partiality to any person or use flattery toward anyone.
text_cn: 我决不顾情面，也决不奉承人。

text_en: For I do not know how to flatter— or my Maker would soon put an end to me!
text_cn: 因为我不会奉承，不然，造我者必立即将我消灭。
